en-US.description: AbaClient allows to log-in into your Abacus Business Software or AbaWeb - without any internet browser and without having java installed.
en-US.longDescription:
AbaClient combines a Java environment controlled by Abacus with a browser tailored to Abacus needs. The Java environment is based on the open source project OpenJDK which does not cause any Oracle dependencies. The browser allows the use of and for Abacus generated certificates without warning messages.
AbaClient recognises and supports the new "abalink" format, which will be used from Abacus version 2019.
AbaClient also serves as a replacement for the product AbaStart.
en-US.name: AbaClient

zh-CN.description: AbaClient 允许登录您的 Abacus 商业软件或 AbaWeb - 无需任何互联网浏览器，也无需安装 Java。
zh-CN.longDescription:
AbaClient 结合了由 Abacus 控制的 Java 环境和根据 Abacus 需求定制的浏览器。Java 环境基于开放源码项目 OpenJDK，与 Oracle 没有任何依赖关系。浏览器允许使用 Abacus 生成的证书，且不会出现警告信息。
AbaClient 可识别并支持新的“abalink”格式，该格式将从 Abacus 2019 版本开始使用。
AbaClient 还用于替代 AbaStart 产品。
